control.description-key: Displays quote audit activities loaded from the Audit Trail API.

property.name: quoteId
property.description-key: Dataverse column containing the numeric quote ID. This bound property also hosts the control on a model-driven form.

property.name: bearerToken
property.description-key: JWT used in the Authorization header. The Bearer prefix is optional.

property.name: refreshTrigger
property.description-key: Change this value to reload audit events.
